The [[{{PAGENAME}}]] are [[NPCs]] who attend your [[Sermon]] on {{day|Pride}} at the [[Church]]. They are the main source of {{Item|Faith}}.

After the [[Sermon]] they also donate [[money]] into the [[Donation box|Donation Box]]. The number attending [[{{PAGENAME}}]] depends on the number of [[Church bench|Church benches]]/{{Church Rating}}.
